unitInfo.name: Mars
info: Melee

Combat Hunter

Armed with a beamgun and a
monoblade for melee combat

The Mars requires support from
other unit types to be effec-
tive. It relies on flanking
and support effects.

unitInfo.name: Titan
info:
Artillery
   Melee

Artillery Hunter

Armed with a medium-range
railgun and a forcehammer for
melee combat

The Titan strikes enemies from
a distance, then rushes in to
finish them in close combat.

unitInfo.name: Talos
info: Melee

Close Combat Hunter

Armed with an overcharged
beamsaber and light beamguns
on both arms

The Talos tries to engage
enemies in melee combat, but
since it relies entirely on
beam weapons, this unit is
completely ineffective in
magnetic fields.

unitInfo.name: Medusa
info: Melee

Fire Support Hunter

Armed with a huge rapid-fire
missile launcher on its head
and a shockflail for melee
combat

The Medusa's primary role is
the defense of fortresses and
capital ships. The exposed
missile pods are both its
greatest strength and weak-
ness.

unitInfo.name: Athena
info:
Convert
   Bomb

Convertible Hunter
(Fighter-Bomber Mode)

Armed with a rapid-fire rail-
gun and one anti-ship torpedo

The fighter-bomber form has
better mobility and bombard-
ment capability, whereas the
Hunter form is more versatile
and can fight in melee.

unitInfo.name: Athena
info:
Convert
   Bomb

Convertible Hunter
(Fighter-Bomber Mode)

Armed with a rapid-fire rail-
gun and one anti-ship torpedo

The fighter-bomber form has
better mobility and bombard-
ment capability, whereas the
Hunter form is more versatile
and can fight in melee.

unitInfo.name: Athena
info:
Convert
   Melee

Convertible Hunter
(Hunter Mode)

Armed with a rail rifle
and a monosaber for melee
combat

The fighter-bomber form has
better mobility and bombard-
ment capability, whereas the
Hunter form is more versatile
and can fight in melee.

unitInfo.name: Athena
info:
Convert
   Melee

Convertible Hunter
(Hunter Mode)

Armed with a rail rifle
and a monosaber for melee
combat

The fighter-bomber form has
better mobility and bombard-
ment capability, whereas the
Hunter form is more versatile
and can fight in melee.

unitInfo.name: Lobster
info:
Interceptor

Armed with twin pulse beam
cannons

Excellent speed and attack
against fighters and Hunters.
It can be used to gain super-
iority in an area and deny
enemy operations.

unitInfo.name: Crane
info:
Heavy Fighter
A more versatile unit than the
Lobster, the Crane is armed
with both a light railgun for
dogfights and anti-ship
missile pods.

The Crane can counter a
variety of enemies, creating
openings for other units
to advance.

unitInfo.name: Brontes
info:
Bomb
   and Move

Heavy Bomber

Armed with a large anti-ship
torpedo.
Mobility and defense change
depending on payload.

The most powerful counter to
warships. It becomes a prime
target when carrying a pay-
load and always requires
support.

unitInfo.name: Brontes
info:
Bomb
   and Move

Heavy Bomber

Armed with a large anti-ship
torpedo.
Mobility and defense change
depending on payload.

The most powerful counter to
warships. It becomes a prime
target when carrying a pay-
load and always requires
support.

unitInfo.name: Horus
info:
Bomb
   and Move

Light Bomber

A railgun for dogfights and
one anti-ship missile (150) at
one to two hexes. Re-arms on
any carrier or dock.

The bomber the Brontes
replaced, still built in
remnant yards because it is
cheap. Fly pairs behind a
fighter screen: the missile
finishes a wounded cruiser
from two hexes, then run home
to re-arm. Fragile once spent.

unitInfo.name: Vulcan
info:
Ranged
   Attack II

Pulse Gunboat

Armed with a long-range pulse
beam cannon

Can't fire after moving

The Vulcan uses active radar
to accurately target and shoot
down distant enemies. Its
attack power is immense and
poses a significant threat to
Hunters.

unitInfo.name: Phoibos
info:
Ranged
   Attack II

Rail Gunboat

Armed with two four-barreled
battleship-grade railcannons

Can't fire after moving

It attacks from outside the
range of rapid-fire weapons
to counter enemy warships,
but is always vulnerable to
Hunters and fighters.

unitInfo.name: Cyclops
info:
Ranged
   Attack II

Missile Boat

Armed with both rapid-fire and
armor-piercing long-range
missile launchers

The long range of its missiles
allows the Cyclops to attack
from behind obstacles before
it can be targeted

unitInfo.name: Pandora
info: Defence

Armed Mine

A space mine fitted with two
railguns. It cannot move but
fires on anything in range.

Laid across gates and cannon
lanes, Pandoras turn a mine-
field into a battery. Clear
them from outside their
three-hex reach.

unitInfo.name: Wisp
info: No Attack

Space Mine

Used to delay enemy movement.
Vulnerable to rapid-fire
attacks.
Deployed by transport ships.

A common strategy is to stop
an enemy invasion with Wisps
and then shell the area with
long-range weapons as the
enemies try to clear the
mines.

unitInfo.name: Remora
info: No Attack

Decoy Drone

A slow, unarmed drone that
mimics a warship's signature.
Hard to hit.

The Union screens its
advance with Remoras. Every
shot spent on one is a shot
not spent on the fleet.

unitInfo.name: Echidna
info:
Beam
   Battery

Beam Pod

A slow gun pod with twin
beam cannons reaching two
hexes.

Echidnas hold chokepoints in
the asteroid belts. Beam-proof
terrain and missiles deal with
them best.

unitInfo.name: Naga
info:
Railgun
   Battery

Rail Pod

A slow gun pod with a long
railgun reaching three hexes.

The Naga guards mining
stations. It cannot chase, so
flank it or outrange it.

unitInfo.name: Rockeye
info:
Railgun
   Battery

Twin Rail Pod

A slow gun pod with two
railguns reaching three hexes.

Rockeyes are deployed in
pairs around fortresses.
Their crossfire makes the
approach costly.

unitInfo.name: Dragon
info:
Beam Turret

A long-range beam cannon that
can be installed on fortress
decks, asteroids and bedrock.
Transported as cargo.

The Dragon has long range and
great attack power. However,
it is unusable in magnetic
fields.

unitInfo.name: Hydra
info:
Missile Turret

Armed with long-range rapid-
fire missiles.
The strongest counter to
fighters and Hunters.

The Hydra can intercept enemy
Hunters outside of their en-
gagement range.
Its primary functions are
fortress defense and sup-
porting the front line.

unitInfo.name: Rahab
info:
Moves on
   Rails

Train Cannon

Armed with both rapid-fire
and armor-piercing beam
cannons

Moves on a railway network
installed on a fortress deck.
Rather than an independent
unit, it can be seen as a
part of the fortress itself.

unitInfo.name: Crab
info: Transport

Transport Ship

The Crab is fast and can load
a small unit into its cargo
bay.

It also transports space mines
and turrets to their deploy-
ment area. Slow-moving units
can be brought to the front
line.
Can't attack while full.

unitInfo.name: Crab
info: Transport

Transport Ship

The Crab is fast and can load
a small unit into its cargo
bay.

It also transports space mines
and turrets to their deploy-
ment area. Slow-moving units
can be brought to the front
line.
Can't attack while full.

unitInfo.name: Camelii
info: Transport

Transport Ship

No guns. Carries one small
machine at move 7 and sets a
Dragon or Hydra battery down
on bedrock or asteroid.

Ruess's long-haul ferry. It
brings slow mecha and
batteries to the front faster
than they walk. Keep it behind
the line: at 10% evasion
anything that reaches it sinks
it, and whatever it carries.

unitInfo.name: Tiamat
info:
Large
   Warship

Battleship

Armed with four triple-barrel
beam cannons and thirty-two
pulsebeam point-defense
turrets.

The Tiamat is often used as
the primary attack vessel
against ships and fortresses
and also commonly serves as
the flagship of a fleet.

unitInfo.name: Asura-Ii
info: Large

Advanced Battleship

Armed with two four-barrel
railguns as main cannons and
ten rapid-fire missile pods.
The strongest battleship.

The Asura-II can move as fast
as a cruiser while attacking
with the full power of a
battleship.
It often serves as the flag-
ship of a fleet.

unitInfo.name: Nodens
info: Large

Fortified Battleship

Armed with five large internal
missile tubes
Turretless design enables
extra armor-plating

The Nodens' entire hull is
reinforced with special armor
layers, providing exceptional
protection to its powerful
missile launchers. It's very
hard to destroy.

unitInfo.name: Hastur
info:
Carrier
   Large

Cruiser-Carrier

Armed with four main beam
cannons and railguns for
protection

The Hastur combines the fire-
power of a cruiser with the
support abilities of a
carrier.
It's vulnerable to enemies
at close range.

unitInfo.name: Artemis
info:
Carrier
   Large

Catapult Carrier

Large carrier with two flight
decks and a launch catapult
for a two hex boost

Deployed as a mobile base
behind the front line.

The Artemis can launch up to
eighteen units at once.

unitInfo.name: Iris
info:
Carrier
   Large

Carrier

Armed with medium-range rapid-
fire missiles

The Iris is used as a front-
line base for Hunter and
fighter operations.

As its defenses are weak, it
requires escort vessels.

unitInfo.name: Siren
info:
Carrier
   Convert

Convertible Carrier
(Carrier Mode)

In carrier mode, the main guns
are rotated below the flight
deck, so they can't be fired

As each of the modes has its
own strengths and weaknesses,
the Siren must always consider
what the tactical situation
requires.

unitInfo.name: Siren
info:
Carrier
   Convert

Convertible Carrier
(Battleship Mode)
In battleship mode, the main
guns are deployed on the
flight deck, so units can't
launch or land

As each of the modes has its
own strengths and weaknesses,
the Siren must always consider
what the tactical situation
requires.

unitInfo.name: Selene
info:
Carrier
   Large

Fast Carrier

With a design focussed on
mobility, its movement speed
surpasses that of cruisers.

Its speed allows the Selene
to flank enemy positions, re-
cover and repair damaged units
and operate beyond the front
line.

unitInfo.name: Hannibal
info:
Heavy Cruiser

Armed with three medium-range
armor-piercing beam turrets
and twenty-eight rapid-fire
railguns for point-defense

A mainstay of fleet battles
and support operations, the
Hannibal serves as a fire
support and escort vessel.

unitInfo.name: Regulus
info:
Escort Cruiser

Armed with thirty-eight pulse
beam turrets and several
missile pods

The Regulus screens the fleet
from Hunters and fighters.

It is mainly used to escort
carriers, but can also assault
Hunter squadrons on its own.

unitInfo.name: Palmyra
info:
Missile
   Barrage

Missile Frigate

A light cruiser built around
long-range missile racks.

The Palmyra hits from beyond
most escorts' reach. Keep it
behind the line: its hull is
thin.

unitInfo.name: Corvus
info: Melee

Claw Cruiser

Armed with melee claws, rail-
gun cannons and several point-
defense turrets

The Corvus can eject remote-
controlled claws to attack
enemy Hunters and warships.

It is the only capital ship
capable of close combat.

unitInfo.name: Abaddon
info:
Quantum
   Bomb

Quantum Bomber

Carries one Quantum Decimator
bomb

The bomb's attack power can't
be reduced unless the ship is
destroyed.
The Decimator annihilates
all units and terrain in a two
hex radius.

unitInfo.name: Abaddon
info:
Quantum
   Bomb

Quantum Bomber

Carries one Quantum Decimator
bomb

The bomb's attack power can't
be reduced unless the ship is
destroyed.
The Decimator annihilates
all units and terrain in a two
hex radius.

unitInfo.name: Msnp-Ii
info:
Bomb
   and Move

Heavy Bomber

A pulse beam and one heavy
missile (230) at two to four
hexes, the hardest single hit
a bomber carries. Slow while
loaded.

The Union mass-produced it for
the end of the war, and
Kessrin kept every one. As a
stand-off ship killer it fires
from four hexes behind a wall
of mecha, then a carrier
scoops it up to re-arm.

unitInfo.name: Msfb-5
info:
Bomb
   and Move

Strike Bomber

A railgun that keeps biting
after the strike and one heavy
missile (200) at two to four
hexes. Hard to hit (60%).

The Security Directorate's own
bomber, built to live through
what kills an MSNP-II. Its
evasion lets it loiter near
the front, fire, and still
duel interceptors with the
railgun.

unitInfo.name: Fenrir
info:
Fire and
   Move

Interdiction Destroyer

Armed with four eight-barrel
turrets for a total of thirty-
two guns
Excels at hit-and-run tactics

Utilizing its high mobility,
the Fenrir is capable of con-
ducting preemptive attacks
against enemy Hunters while
maneuvering difficult terrain.

unitInfo.name: Cerberus
info:
Fire and
   Move

Light Destroyer

Armed with two eight-barrel
rapid-fire railguns and six
missile tubes

It packs less attack power
than other destroyers and is
often used to deliver the
finishing blow to damaged
enemy vessels.

unitInfo.name: Gulon
info:
Fire and
   Move

Assault Destroyer

Armed with a fixed quadruple
railgun and small short-range
missile pods

The Gulon is a shock unit that
rushes into the heart of enemy
formations, hits a vulnerable
ship with a massive blast and
withdraws before they can re-
taliate.

unitInfo.name: Pergamon
info:
Def. Fire
   Repairs

Space Dock

Can be captured by reducing
its HP to zero with rapid-
fire or melee attacks

Units other than battleships
and carriers can enter an
allied dock to receive main-
tenance and repairs

unitInfo.name: Solomon
info:
Defensive
   Fire only

Small Sector Fortress

Vulnerable to armor-piercing,
melee and bombing attacks.

A sector fortress serves as
the local command center and
military headquarters.

unitInfo.name: Carthago
info:
Defensive
   Fire only

Medium Sector Fortress

Vulnerable to armor-piercing,
melee and bombing attacks.

Carthago is equipped with
extra armor plates to allow
deployment at the front line.

It can serve as a command cen-
ter even while under fire.

unitInfo.name: Goliath
info:
Defensive
   Fire only

Large Sector Fortress

Vulnerable to armor-piercing,
melee and bombing attacks.

The Goliath fortress is
heavily armored and armed with
powerful cannons for reaction
fire.
It's advisable to attack it
from a safe distance.

unitInfo.name: Cortex
info: Unarmed

Command Center

Vulnerable to armor-piercing,
melee and bomb attacks

A field headquarters that co-
ordinates all troop movement.
Larger areas require more than
one command center.

unitInfo.name: Adzam
info:
Buccaneer
   Cannon

Command Center which controls
the Buccaneer Cannon

Vulnerable to armor-piercing,
melee and bomb attacks

Destroying Adzam will prevent
the Buccaneer Cannon from
firing

unitInfo.name: Selene Kai
info:
Carrier
   Large

Fast Carrier (Refit)

A railgun against craft and a
beam turret (77) for ships at
one to two hexes. Carries any
number of craft at move 10.

Captain Sato refused a new
ship and had Ruess rebuild her
old Selene instead. It outruns
every warship: load a strike
wing, sprint to the flank,
launch, and pull back before
the cruisers turn. Thin
armour: never park it in their
range.

unitInfo.name: Leviathan
info:
Large
   Warship

Directorate Flagship

Beam batteries (154) against
craft, missile cells (255) at
two to five hexes, railguns at
one to three, a hangar; 60 HP,
78% evasion.

Marshal Kessrin's flagship,
laid down in secret while the
war still raged. It kills
almost anything it reaches.
Strip its escort, then
surround it with many
attackers so every hit counts;
an Abaddon's Decimator ends it
from four hexes.

unitInfo.name: Directorate Talos
info:
Melee
   Elite

Elite Close Combat Hunter

A long beamsaber (140) in
melee and a pulse gun; move 5
and 65% evasion.

Commander Vane's machine; the
Directorate's picked guards
fly the rest. It cuts a Mars
in half before the Mars can
answer. Don't duel it: pin it
with railguns and missiles
from two hexes, or catch it in
a magnetic field where its
saber fails.

unitInfo.name: Azoras
info:
Beam
   Large

General's Flagship

Missile pods (90) at one to
two hexes, heavy wing beams
(120) at two to four and a
close-in railgun; move 9 and a
hangar.

Built in hidden yards to carry
the General: a battlecruiser
with a carrier's hangar and a
destroyer's engines. With the
General aboard it is the
strongest ship on the field
and the one the enemy must
kill. Fight at beam range with
escorts on its flanks. Unique.

unitInfo.name: Pallas
info:
Convert
   Bomb

Transforming Ace
(Fighter-Bomber Mode)

Nose beams (48) and one
anti-ship torpedo (255) at two
hexes: the heaviest strike any
craft carries. Move 10.

The Athena's successor, a new
frame from nose to heel, built
for the remnant's best pilot.
Open as a fighter and put the
torpedo into a capital ship,
then turn hunter and hold the
line until a carrier re-arms
you. Unique.

unitInfo.name: Pallas
info:
Convert
   Fighter

Transforming Ace
(Fighter Mode)

Nose beams (48); the torpedo
is spent and re-arms on any
carrier or dock.

The Athena's successor, a new
frame from nose to heel, built
for the remnant's best pilot.
Open as a fighter and put the
torpedo into a capital ship,
then turn hunter and hold the
line until a carrier re-arms
you. Unique.

unitInfo.name: Pallas
info:
Convert
   Melee

Transforming Ace
(Hunter Mode)

A railgun (102) that answers
fire up to three hexes and a
beamsaber (140) in melee; 70%
evasion.

The Athena's successor, a new
frame from nose to heel, built
for the remnant's best pilot.
Open as a fighter and put the
torpedo into a capital ship,
then turn hunter and hold the
line until a carrier re-arms
you. Unique.

unitInfo.name: Pallas
info:
Convert
   Melee

Transforming Ace
(Hunter Mode)

A railgun (102) that answers
fire up to three hexes and a
beamsaber (140) in melee; 70%
evasion.

The Athena's successor, a new
frame from nose to heel, built
for the remnant's best pilot.
Open as a fighter and put the
torpedo into a capital ship,
then turn hunter and hold the
line until a carrier re-arms
you. Unique.

unitInfo.name: Lobster Kai
info:
Fast
   Beam

Interceptor (Refit)

A heavy pulse beam (128) at
one to two hexes and a light
missile (77) that hits
anything, ships included. Move
12.

Ruess's refit of the Lobster:
bigger engines, a longer beam,
a missile rack. The fastest
machine in the sky. From two
hexes its beam hits craft
whose guns can't answer, so it
hunts bombers and finishes the
wounded untouched, and its
missile chips at stray ships.

unitInfo.name: Crane Kai
info: Missile

Fighter-Bomber (Refit)

A railgun (77) for dogfights
and a ship missile (128) at
one to two hexes; 60% evasion.

Ruess's refit of the Crane.
Its missile reaches warships
from two hexes, beyond most
point defence, and it is very
hard to pin down. Send pairs
against cruisers and carriers,
then fall back behind the
mecha line.

unitInfo.name: Titan Kai
info:
Long
   Range

Long-Range Mecha (Refit)

A long railgun (102) against
craft at two to four hexes, an
anti-ship battery (90) at two
to three and a close-in gun
(64).

Ruess's refit of the Titan, a
mecha that shoots like a
warship. Plant it on asteroid
or bedrock behind the line: it
breaks attacks from four hexes
and answers the ships behind
them. Slow, so guard its
flanks.

unitInfo.name: Mars Kai
info: Melee

Mecha (Refit)

A stronger beam rifle (77) and
a heavy close-in railgun (96)
that hits ships too; move 6,
50% evasion.

Ruess's refit of the Mars:
cheap, quick and hard to hit.
Buy them in numbers to hold
chokepoints, take docks and
soak the hits meant for your
aces; the railgun finishes any
ship that strays too close.

unitInfo.name: Cyclops Kai
info:
Moves or
   Fires

Missile Boat (Refit)

Missiles against craft (140)
at two to five hexes and ship
missiles (190) at two to six.
Moves or fires.

Ruess turned the Cyclops into
a missile boat that out-ranges
everything the remnant flies.
Hide it behind the line, let
the enemy come, and fire from
six hexes; missiles fly
through the magnetic fields
that stop beams. Never let
craft reach it.

unitInfo.name: Fenrir Kai
info:
Fire and
   Move

Destroyer (Refit)

A heavy railgun (140) against
craft and a ship missile
battery (115) at two to three
hexes. Moves again after
firing.

Ruess's refit of the Fenrir,
built for hit-and-run: dash
in, fire, and use the movement
left to slip back behind the
line before the enemy turn.
Tougher than the old Fenrir,
and it docks on the Hephaestus
for repairs.

unitInfo.name: Asura-II Kai
info:
Battleship
   Large

Battleship (Refit)

A huge rail battery (220)
against ships at two to four
hexes and close-in missiles
(165); 22 HP, move 7.

Ruess's gun battleship: the
Asura-II rebuilt around a rail
battery that guts a carrier in
one volley. It wins every ship
duel at range. Keep mecha in
front and let it fire over
them; craft that slip under
its guns are its real danger.

unitInfo.name: Athena Kai
info:
Convert
   Missile

Transforming Fighter (Refit)
(Fighter Mode)

A railgun (38) and a torpedo
(240) for capital ships at two
hexes; move 10.

Ruess's refit of the Athena,
faster and harder to hit in
both shapes, and not unique: a
whole wing can fly them.
Strike with the torpedoes,
turn hunter and fight from two
hexes while a carrier waits to
re-arm the wing.

unitInfo.name: Athena Kai
info: Convert

Transforming Fighter (Refit)
(Fighter Mode, spent)

A railgun (38); the torpedo
re-arms on any carrier or
dock.

Ruess's refit of the Athena,
faster and harder to hit in
both shapes, and not unique: a
whole wing can fly them.
Strike with the torpedoes,
turn hunter and fight from two
hexes while a carrier waits to
re-arm the wing.

unitInfo.name: Athena Kai
info:
Convert
   Melee

Transforming Fighter (Refit)
(Hunter Mode)

A railgun (102) at two to
three hexes and a heavy melee
gun (128); 55% evasion.

Ruess's refit of the Athena,
faster and harder to hit in
both shapes, and not unique: a
whole wing can fly them.
Strike with the torpedoes,
turn hunter and fight from two
hexes while a carrier waits to
re-arm the wing.

unitInfo.name: Athena Kai
info:
Convert
   Melee

Transforming Fighter (Refit)
(Hunter Mode)

A railgun (102) at two to
three hexes and a heavy melee
gun (128); 55% evasion.

Ruess's refit of the Athena,
faster and harder to hit in
both shapes, and not unique: a
whole wing can fly them.
Strike with the torpedoes,
turn hunter and fight from two
hexes while a carrier waits to
re-arm the wing.

unitInfo.name: Nineveh
info:
Carrier
   Fortress

Fortress Ship

Babylon's main cannon (255) at
two to six hexes, missile
cells (200) at one to four,
beam batteries (170) and a
hangar; 90 HP.

Babylon's sister, laid down at
Asgard and never in any Union
record; Ahriman finished her
in Earth's shadow. Towers on
her hull feed a cannon that
sweeps three lanes: kill them
with craft that climb the
hull, never end a move in a
lane, then swarm her.

unitInfo.name: Azoras Kai
info:
Carrier
   Large

Flagship (Refit)

Missiles (120) at one to three
hexes, a beam battery (160) at
two to five and railguns (110)
at one to two; 44 HP, move 10,
70% evasion.

Ruess rebuilt the Azoras from
keel to crown for the last
battle. With the General
aboard nothing in Kessrin's
fleet matches it at any range.
Its price would buy a fleet,
and it is worth one. Unique.

unitInfo.name: Hephaestus
info:
Carrier
   Repair

Repair Ship (Dock)

No guns. Every ally beside it
regains 5 HP each turn; craft,
cruisers and destroyers board
it for a full repair.

Ruess's answer to a war with
no safe harbour: a drydock
with engines. Park it a hex
behind the battle line and
rotate wounded ships beside
it. Slow and thin-skinned, and
the enemy hunts it right after
the General: never leave it
unescorted.

unitInfo.name: Directorate Medusa
info:
Missile
   Elite

Elite Fire Support Hunter

A rebuilt missile pod (102)
that reaches craft two hexes
